title: UI Specification
description: Schema for validating the metadata envelope of a UI_Spec.md produced by Agente09_UxUiDesigner. The actual component spec is Markdown prose — this schema validates the machine-readable summary.

feature.description: Feature name matching the PRD and UX Flow feature name.

implementation_target.description: The agent that will implement this specification.

components.description: All components specified in this UI_Spec document.

route.description: URL route this component belongs to.

component_type.description: Whether this is a React Server Component or Client Component.

client_component_justification.description: Required when component_type is 'Client Component'. Must justify: interactivity / browser API / real-time.

fetches_async_data.description: True if this component fetches data asynchronously. If true, all 4 states are mandatory.

has_loading_state.description: True if a loading skeleton state is specified.

has_error_state.description: True if an error state is specified.

has_empty_state.description: True if an empty state is specified.

has_populated_state.description: True if a populated (data-filled) state is specified.

has_props_interface.description: True if a TypeScript props interface is included.

has_responsive_table.description: True if a responsive behavior table (breakpoint → layout change) is included.

has_accessibility_section.description: True if an accessibility section (focus order, ARIA, keyboard behavior) is included.

has_exact_copy_text.description: True if all user-facing text is exact final copy (no placeholder text).

design_tokens_only.description: True if all visual properties use generic design tokens (no hardcoded hex values).

wireframe_ref.description: Reference to the corresponding wireframe in Wireframes.md.

prd_requirements.description: PRD acceptance criteria this component satisfies.

aria_label.description: ARIA label value for this element.
